text:
Artificial intelligence is changing how we create art, music, and writing. AI programs can now paint pictures in famous styles, compose symphonies, and write poems or stories in seconds. Some people are amazed by these results, while others worry that machines are replacing human imagination.

However, there is a key difference. A human artist draws from personal experiences, emotions, and cultural memories. AI, on the other hand, learns from existing data and combines patterns in new ways. It can imitate creativity, but it does not truly feel or understand what it makes.

Perhaps the best approach is collaboration. Humans can use AI as a tool to explore fresh ideas, while still adding their own emotional depth. In this way, technology expands creativity rather than replacing it.
